items.title: Al Chez interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, February 13, 2019
items.q: Did he like the band like Johnny Carson seemed to like his band?

ctx.x: Yeah. He’s out in Montana, that’s where he is. Him and Tom Brokaw bought two farms in the middle of Montana back to back. So if you look at a map I think the whole middle of the state of Montana is owned by Letterman/Brokaw.
Did he like the band like Johnny Carson seemed to like his band?

Oh he loved the band. Before he had all his heart problems he would come and he would play the drums and he would do — we would do our rehearsal, then he would do the comedy rehearsal, then he would go — oh excuse me. It would be the comedy rehearsal, then he would come over and he would play the drums. Every day. And then when Dave got finished playing the drums then we had the music rehearsal. He loved it. He was always coming by and play this and play that and can you sing this, you know what I mean? So I…
